metadata.audit_standard: Principal Neural 3D Engineer & ML Infrastructure Lead
metadata.evaluation_objective: Determine suitability of genuine feed-forward image-to-3D models for wearable garments

candidates.input_requirements: Single RGBA image with transparent background (512x512)
candidates.output_topology: Tripo-style textured mesh (.glb), non-separated panels, closed watertight envelope
candidates.texture_capabilities: Bake material maps (albedo, normal, roughness), resolution 1024x1024

reasons: Generates monolithic watertight mesh without semantic boundary loops (neck, cuffs, hem closed)
Lacks body-to-garment ease grading required for multi-archetype virtual try-on
Cannot isolate individual pattern components (collar stand, placket, kangaroo pocket)
Skinning to 20-bone humanoid skeleton fails due to non-manifold self-intersections

candidates.input_requirements: Single RGB image with foreground mask
candidates.output_topology: Marching Cubes isosurface extraction from feed-forward NeRF / LRM
candidates.gpu_requirements: CUDA GPU >= 6GB VRAM (or Apple Silicon MPS)

reasons: Marching cubes creates noisy, faceted isosurfaces unsuitable for XPBD cloth simulation
No semantic openings; internal volume is solid or inverted
Severe high-frequency geometric artifacts on thin fabric silhouettes

candidates.output_topology: Structured Latent Flow Radiance Fields decoded to high-res mesh

reasons: High inference latency (12.4s) exceeds interactive virtual try-on SLAs (< 3s)
Generates dense rigid 3D object geometry rather than parametric pattern panels
High VRAM requirements prohibit local client-side execution

candidates.input_requirements: Single RGB image or multi-view prompts
candidates.output_topology: Two-stage multi-view diffusion + 3D DiT shape generation

reasons: Extreme runtime (38.6s) and memory consumption (22.4GB VRAM)
Produces solid general 3D sculpture without wearable cavity or avatar rig skinning
Requires dedicated multi-GPU cloud cluster incurring high operational cost

candidates.output_topology: Multi-view diffusion + Large Gaussian Model (LGM) / NeRF mesh extraction

reasons: Watertight outer mesh wraps around avatar rather than functioning as open wearable garment
Lacks category-specific opening boundaries and pattern panel topology
High VRAM requirement incompatible with staging worker environments

local_production_engine.engine_name: Contour-Carved Parametric Reconstruction & Semantic Albedo Projection
local_production_engine.classification: Hybrid Image-Conditioned Parametric Pattern Deformation Engine

provenance.perception: SegFormer B2 human parsing segmenter (18 semantic classes, 512x512)
provenance.contour_extraction: 24-radial ray contour carving with bilateral ease compensation
provenance.geometry_generation: Category-specific parametric pattern panels with 2-manifold boundary openings
provenance.component_graph: Explicit ComponentGraph with stable component IDs and representation taxonomy
provenance.texture_synthesis: Perspective-corrected photographic albedo projection with specular/roughness map synthesis
provenance.rigging: 20-bone Ara 3D Gen anatomic skeleton skinning with dual-quaternion smooth binding

runtime_environment.local_accelerator: Apple Silicon M2 MPS (16GB Unified Memory)

local_production_engine.production_justification: Retained as primary production engine because generic feed-forward neural 3D models produce closed watertight sculptures that cannot be worn, sized, or physically simulated on avatars.
